stories.headline: DeepSeek Suffers 7+ Hour Outage, Longest Since Its Viral Debut in Early 2025

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek's chatbot suffered a major outage of more than seven hours overnight in China on March 29-30, its biggest since its viral debut in early 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek down for 7 hours in biggest outage since debut, services restored

key_facts.fact: Users reported 'server busy' errors on both the web app and mobile app, with conversations interrupted and content lost. '#DeepSeek崩了' trended on Weibo.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek突发大规模服务中断，网页端和App提示'服务器繁忙'等，对话中断及内容丢失，'DeepSeek崩了'很快登上热搜

key_facts.fact: Some Chinese media reported the service disruption lasted up to 12 hours, with issues persisting into March 30 morning.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek出现12小时服务异常

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek deployed several updates to rectify the issue; the company said it was investigating the cause of the outage.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek down for 7 hours in biggest outage since debut, services restored

key_facts.fact: Users reflected on their dependence on the tool: 'Only after DeepSeek went down did I realise I no longer knew how to work without it,' one user posted.
key_facts.excerpt: Only after DeepSeek went down did I realise I no longer knew how to work without it

stories.headline: Eli Lilly and Insilico Medicine Sign $2.75B AI Drug Discovery Deal With $115M Upfront

key_facts.fact: Eli Lilly signed a deal worth up to $2.75 billion with Hong Kong-listed AI drug developer Insilico Medicine, including $115 million in upfront payments.
key_facts.excerpt: Eli Lilly has signed a $2.75 billion deal with Hong Kong-listed AI pharmaceutical

key_facts.fact: Insilico CEO Alex Zhavoronkov said the company has developed at least 28 drugs using generative AI, with nearly half already in clinical trials.
key_facts.excerpt: Insilico has created at least 28 pharmaceuticals using generative AI, with nearly half currently undergoing clinical trials

key_facts.fact: Additional payments beyond the $115M upfront are tied to regulatory approvals, commercial achievements, and licensing fees.
key_facts.excerpt: Additional compensation tied to regulatory approvals, commercial achievements, and licensing fees

key_facts.fact: Insilico develops its AI models in Canada and the Middle East, and conducts early-stage drug development in China. The companies have collaborated since 2023.
key_facts.excerpt: AI development: Canada and Middle East. Early-stage drug development: China

key_facts.fact: Andrew Adams from Lilly described Insilico's research as 'a powerful complement' to the company's clinical development capabilities.
key_facts.excerpt: Andrew Adams from Lilly described Insilico's research as 'a powerful complement' to the company's clinical development capabilities

key_facts.fact: Lilly is simultaneously engaged with a DeepMind subsidiary on similar AI drug development projects, signaling a broader commitment to AI in pharma.
key_facts.excerpt: Lilly is pursuing multiple AI-driven drug development initiatives; the company is simultaneously engaged with a DeepMind subsidiary on similar projects

stories.headline: Mistral Raises $830M in Debut Debt Financing for Paris-Area AI Data Center

key_facts.fact: French AI startup Mistral raised $830 million in its first-ever debt financing, backed by seven banks including BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole CIB, HSBC, and MUFG.
key_facts.excerpt: Seven banks financed the deal: BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole CIB, HSBC, MUFG

key_facts.fact: The funds will be used to purchase 13,800 Nvidia chips and build a data center in Bruyères-le-Châtel near Paris, expected to become operational in Q2 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Mistral plans to acquire 13,800 Nvidia chips through this financing...facility will be built in Bruyeres-le-Chatel near Paris and is expected to become operational in Q2 2026

key_facts.fact: The debt financing is the first major deal of its kind to fund European AI infrastructure, reflecting Mistral's push for 'sovereign AI' in Europe.
key_facts.excerpt: French AI startup Mistral has secured $830 million in debt financing. The funds will go towards operating a data center near Paris

key_facts.fact: The transaction reflects growing investor confidence in European AI companies challenging U.S. tech dominance in AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: The transaction demonstrates growing investor confidence in European AI companies seeking to challenge U.S. tech dominance in cloud computing and artificial intelligence services

sources.title: France's Mistral raises $830 million in debt for AI data centre build-up
Mistral secures $830 million in debt financing to fund AI data center
Mistral raises $830 million in debt to buy Nvidia chips for Paris data center

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Codex Plugins With 20+ Integrations as Sora Compute Shifts to Coding

key_facts.fact: OpenAI launched Codex Plugins on March 29, packaging skills, app connectors, and resource configurations into shareable bundles that expand Codex beyond code generation into workflow automation.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI has added new plugins to its Codex development tool, enabling users to package skills and app integrations into shareable, installable bundles

key_facts.fact: Over 20 plugins are available at launch, including integrations with Figma, Notion, Gmail, Google Drive, and Slack across the Codex app, CLI, and VS Code extension.
key_facts.excerpt: Over 20 plugins currently exist, including connections to Figma, Notion, Gmail, Google Drive, and Slack across the Codex app, CLI, and VS Code extension

key_facts.fact: Codex has over 2 million monthly active users and is priced at $200/month. OpenAI is redirecting freed GPU compute from the shuttered Sora video tool to Codex.
key_facts.excerpt: Over 2 million monthly active users...Codex lead Thibault 'Tibo' Sottiaux confirmed the shift

key_facts.fact: Codex may be merged with ChatGPT and Atlas into a unified 'super app' as OpenAI focuses resources on coding and reasoning after discontinuing Sora.
key_facts.excerpt: May merge with ChatGPT and Atlas into a unified 'super app'

key_facts.fact: A Plugin Directory is planned but not yet fully accessible; OpenAI has not announced a timeline for external plugin submissions.
key_facts.excerpt: A Plugin Directory is planned but not fully accessible in the current release

stories.headline: Pro-AI PAC Innovation Council Action Plans $100M+ Spending in 2026 US Midterms

key_facts.fact: Innovation Council Action, a new pro-AI political group, plans to spend over $100 million in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections to support candidates favoring AI deregulation.
key_facts.excerpt: New pro-AI PAC preps $100M midterm blitz to boost Trump's agenda

key_facts.fact: The group is led by Taylor Budowich, a former Trump aide who previously ran the MAGA Inc. super PAC, and is championed by tech investor David Sacks, Trump's White House AI advisor.
key_facts.excerpt: Led by Taylor Budowich, former Trump aide who previously ran MAGA Inc...Championed by David Sacks, tech investor and Trump's AI advisor

key_facts.fact: Budowich stated: 'President Trump has made it clear, America will win the AI race against China, period...this organization exists to make sure he doesn't fight that battle alone.'
key_facts.excerpt: President Trump has made it clear, America will win the AI race against China, period...this organization exists to make sure he doesn't fight that battle alone

key_facts.fact: The group has developed a scorecard ranking lawmakers based on their alignment with Trump's AI priorities, which will guide spending decisions.
key_facts.excerpt: Developed a scorecard ranking lawmakers based on their alignment with Trump's AI priorities

key_facts.fact: Other pro-AI groups include Leading the Future ($50M raised from Marc Andreessen and Joe Lonsdale) and a Meta-backed super PAC expecting to spend ~$65 million on state-level races.
key_facts.excerpt: Leading the Future: raised $50 million from tech figures including Marc Andreessen and Joe Lonsdale. Meta-backed super PAC: projected to spend ~$65 million
